protocol.partition: Seeded allocation of existing company daily starts and exits weighted by available group stock; no transfers or person records.
protocol.methodSelection: Fixed before evaluation; no winner chosen from assessment scores.

interval.quantile: order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.9), no interpolation; unavailable if rank exceeds n
interval.yearEndInterval: unavailable; reserved quarter not used for validation
interval.qualificationTiming: Retrospective simulation qualification, never available at either historical forecast origin.

protocol.validationUnit: One entire independently seeded history and one held-out assessment-quarter total per family/group; months and calibration folds are not independent samples.
protocol.custody: Protocol committed before new group generation/scoring. Generator and scenario families are visible; seed separation is a constructed simulation validation, not blinded or real-world validation.
protocol.failurePolicy: Keep unavailable folds/groups and failed gates visible. Do not retune ranges, alter seeds, fill missing periods, infer suppressed counts, or change targets after seeing scores.

extendedGeneratorConfig.custody: Protocol committed before dataset generation or model evaluation; constructed holdouts are not independently blinded real-world validation.
extendedGeneratorConfig.evaluation: This checkpoint generates, reconciles and replays aggregates only. No predictive performance, causal effect or calibrated interval is claimed.

limitations: Generated group memberships, transition probabilities and availability clocks are assumptions, not observed company history.
Groups share company totals and calendar conditions. Only seed replicates within a family/group are validation units; groups and months are not independent replications.
The frozen primary method is not selected from assessment results. Comparison scores are conditional simulation results only.
Candidate ranges use rolling residuals without established temporal exchangeability; no distribution-free or simultaneous coverage claim.
Gate status is retrospectively computed at the scoring cutoff, not information available at either forecast origin.
Small groups and incomplete histories abstain. Suppression is not a formal or repeated-release privacy guarantee.
October–December remains unscored and all year-end intervals are null. No future exposure means no rate forecast.
Existing hiring, satisfaction, historical extract and UI outputs are unchanged. This experiment does not qualify an operational source adapter.
